QUOTE: "When `hasSearch` is true it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} hideHeader theme topStyle ref={ref} />`" and "The `ref` is only attached when `hasSearch` is true. For the other seven callers it is never attached to anything."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true, and that otherwise the ref is attached to nothing.
